scientific_integrity: The proofs cover nonsmooth convex bodies by the weak support-function identity. Finite angle quadrature is a supplemental numerical consistency test; independent audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact covariance uses planar support Fourier area and independent uniform reflection axes; it does not cover Steiner symmetrization, biased direction distributions, or higher dimension. Historical equivalent calculations may exist.
title: Exact covariance and typical-rate gap for random planar Minkowski symmetrization
